top_choice_rationale: P002 rests on a falsifiable quantitative prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic angle) followed by observed correlated insulating and superconducting states, now reproduced by many laboratories, and it opens a new tunable regime of correlated matter; the citation can be limited to the established flat-band prediction and observed phases, saying nothing of the pairing mechanism. I hold it only narrowly above P001, which has the cleaner two-name credit and greater maturity; the Cao and earlier moire band-theory attribution problem and the short eight-year track record are real weaknesses I acknowledge. P000 is last because both awards are defensible.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; as a theoretical condensed-matter physicist in electronic-structure theory he is close to the moire field, but no specific connection to the nominees is evident
